title: Show when the document was uploaded, under its title
objective: On the document page, show when the document was uploaded, under its title, like "Uploaded Sep 30", in an element with data-testid="uploaded". Dates are UTC. A document uploaded in an earlier year than the store's clock shows the year: "Uploaded Sep 30, 2025".
acceptance: The Q3 Board Deck (d1) reads "Uploaded Sep 30" under its title
A document from an earlier year shows the year, like "Uploaded Sep 30, 2025"
The date is the UTC date
plan_summary: Add formatDate(iso, now) to format.mjs and render it in documentPage.
